## Checklist

- [ ] Every item except the last one in the list ends with a comma
- [ ] Text is in "double quotes", numbers are not
- [ ] `category` and `tags` are spelled exactly as in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] `lat` is about 44 and `lng` is about -79 (not swapped)
- [ ] No one's private phone number, home address or photo without their OK
